deploy-bot: Schedule: migration '2026_07_idx_users_last_active' in prod during 04:00-04:45 UTC. Runtime pinned r12.5. Canary on 1% for 10m; auto-pause if error_rate>2 or p95_read>900ms.
sanjay: plan: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_last_active ON users (last_active DESC); then run rolling backfill to populate partial compaction metadata. Backfill command: `rolling_backfill --shards=10 --batch=400 --sleep=100ms`.
ivy: ops ask: this touches hot PK. Request hard holdpoint at +20m and abort criteria: pg_locks>40 for 90s or replica_lag>3s.
nora: rollback path: stop backfill, flip FF `users_idx_read`->false, and run `deploybot revert-index 2026_07_idx_users_last_active --defer-drop` to leave index build artifacts until safe. Manual approval required to drop.
sanjay: preflight: run dry-run on canary shard and compare counts. Also include quick smoke: `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE last_active IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10000;`.
opsbot: @ivy assigned approver for window. Pager rotation primary: ivy, secondary: nora.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks set for 03:50 UTC. All preflight must pass to proceed. Will post canary results at +10m and holdpoint at +20m.
ivy: I'll be watching p95/p99 and pg_locks. Ping me at 04:11 for canary.
sanjay: will post final readiness 30m before. Thanks.
